title: .NET Microservices: Architecture for Containerized .NET Applications
author: Microsoft (Cesar de la Torre, Bill Wagner, Mike Rousos)
description: Microsoft's official guide to designing and building microservice-based, containerized applications with .NET and Docker. Covers architecture patterns, per-service data, API gateways, resilience, event-driven communication, and deployment, alongside the reference application.
